[Act: constitution
 Chapter: Official Language
 Section: 350A::Facilities for instruction in mother-tongue at primary stage
]


2[It shall be the endeavour of every State and of every local authority within the State to provide adequate facilities for instruction in the mother-tongue at the primary stage of education to children belonging to linguistic minority groups; and the President may issue such directions to any State as he considers necessary or proper for securing the provision of such facilities.
